newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle very slow at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle very slow at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady in light test. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 100 slaughter steers and 100 heifers; following weekly movement of 93,400 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 64.00.
